story.summary: Dave, 34, plays the local disc golf course every Saturday morning; a friendly regular who knows every basket
story.climate: sunny park course, dusty fairways, dewy grass in the morning
story.use: walks 18 holes, digs discs out of bushes, sits on the bag between holes
events: his favourite orange driver has a scuffed rim from hitting trees
the bag's bottom is grass-stained from being set down
